question: As per the Census of India 2011, which state recorded a negative population growth rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nagaland** recorded a negative population growth rate as per the Census of India 2011.
 
• This was a unique occurrence among Indian states during that census period.
 
• The negative growth rate indicates a decline in the population of Nagaland over the decade from 2001 to 2011.
 
• Factors contributing to this decline could include migration, lower birth rates, or other demographic changes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Census of India** is conducted every ten years and is the most comprehensive source of demographic data in the country.
 
• The 2011 Census was the 15th National Census of the country since 1872.
 
• It provides critical data that helps in planning and implementation of various policies and programs by the government.
 
• The census also includes information on various parameters such as population density, sex ratio, literacy rate, and employment status, among others.
 
• Understanding population trends is essential for effective governance and resource allocation.
